impact.headline: 9 builds rescheduled. 79 customer deliveries affected at 36 dealers; 17 Platinum/Gold customers got a loaner, 1 entitled customer is waiting (dealer pool empty).
changed: 9 production orders moved (6 same-plant reschedules, 3 transfers); 6 now build later (avg 4.5 days), 3 earlier at another plant.
36 dealers told about exactly their affected orders (one message each); 17 loaners assigned.
unchanged: 51 of 60 future production orders at P_MS were not affected and were not moved.
61 Standard-tier customers: dealer informed, no loaner (policy rule 5).
1 entitled customer did not get a loaner because the dealer's pool ran out: ['CO-01529']
14 dealers have no affected orders and were not contacted.
No lots held, no vehicles stopped from sale (not part of a delay or outage).
